title: Impending Victory (Gladiator)
problem: Partly disputed. The perk exists only in the damage spell calculation, and there it works: for a damage Arsenal spell the potency stat becomes 50% Intelligence + 50% highest stat. Arsenal spells that don't deal damage (15 of the 25: 8 Boost, 1 Heal, 2 Buff, 4 Utility) never reach that code, so for them it does nothing, although the text covers all Arsenal spells. It also changes nothing when Intelligence is already the highest stat.
notes: Community claim: Doesn't do anything. Evidence: bc_SpellDamage L47-51: perk 596 (@0x1415993fb) && inv_SpellIsEquipment(spellid) -> stat = 0.5 x scr_GetCritNthHighestStatAmt(caster, 1) + 0.5 x stat (@0x1415997a4-0x14159984b); the stat is read later in the formula; no perk-596 site in the heal or stat potency code (perk_signatures). Fix sketch: H (add the same term to the heal / stat potency code), or T ("damage spells") Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Only damaging Arsenal spells reach the code. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "50% of the potency of your creatures' Arsenal spells is based on their highest stat". Fix: H: add the same 0.5 x highest-stat blend to bc_SpellHealing and bc_SpellStat (as in bc_SpellDamage L47-51 @0x1415993fb), e.g. a call-site hook on their potency-stat read gated on perk 596 + inv_SpellIsEquipment. vs bugged: stronger (non-damage Arsenal spells benefit). Batch R: not built. Needs the potency-stat read sites in bc_SpellHealing / bc_SpellStat located and a blend hook gated on perk 596 + inv_SpellIsEquipment. 2026-10-26 hook batch B2 built (research/hooks_B2.json, loader/hooks_B2.c). crit_intelligence(caster) at bc_SpellHealing L16 and bc_SpellStat L22 is wrapped with the damage calculator's own test (scr_PerkLevel(596) > 0 and inv_SpellIsEquipment(spell id)) and blend (0.5 x highest stat + 0.5 x Intelligence). Note: here the blend comes at the first potency-stat read; in bc_SpellDamage it comes after the other stat substitutions. In-game test: With Impending Victory, a creature whose Attack is far above its Intelligence casts a healing or buff Arsenal spell: the potency is based on (Attack + Intelligence) / 2. Non-Arsenal spells and creatures whose highest stat is Intelligence are unchanged.

release_notes.intended: 50% of the potency of your Arsenal spells is based on the highest stat instead of Intelligence.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only Arsenal spells that deal damage got it; healing, buff and stat Arsenal spells did not.
release_notes.fix: Now all Arsenal spells use the blend.
